name: @kickside/transfer-ui
title: KickSide Transfer
description: Exportable-component picker for kickside/transfer: search and multi-select the actor's own exportable components (knowledge bases, agents, skills) and export them.

wippy.description: Export/Import picker web component (kickside-transfer), opened from the profile dropdown account item. It renders its own modal chrome, lists the actor's exportable components from GET /api/v1/transfer/exportable (grouped by class, with search and select-all), exports the selection as a zip archive via POST /api/v1/transfer/export (triggering a browser download), and imports an archive back through POST /api/v1/transfer/import. It takes no props; the authenticated HTTP client comes from the Wippy host via the @wippy-fe/proxy api. Events: selection-change fires with { component_ids } whenever the selection changes, exported fires with { filename, count } after a successful export, and close is emitted when the user dismisses the modal (close button or Escape) — the host owns unmounting the element.
